name: Chaos Wand
oracle_text: {4}, {T}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of that library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of that library in a random order.

needs.what: a `rest_to_bottom` option on `exile_until` that, after the free-cast offer resolves, puts every card the walk exiled (the walked-past cards plus the hit if it was not cast) on the bottom of the walked library's owner's library in a random order -- the cascade/discover tail, on exile_until's selector stop test and `player` walk of another seat's library
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile_until (with player {target: t1}, objects {any_types: [Instant, Sorcery]} and cast_free) does the first two sentences exactly as Strago and Relm does, but by design it leaves every walked card in exile; it binds only the hit via `as`, never links the walked-past cards to the source (no `link`, so `exiled_with` cannot find them), and `else_destination` moves only the hit. `cascade` and `discover` bottom the rest but walk only the controller's library with a mana-value stop test; `reveal_until` bottoms the rest but reveals rather than exiles and cannot offer an immediate free cast (only a later `playable_free` permission, leaving an uncast hit in exile instead of on the bottom).
